verdict.rationale: Qodo lets teams define centralized rules/engineering standards (qodo-docs-12, qodo-docs-13) that are automatically applied and enforced when a PR event occurs, since Qodo automatically reviews every PR in the repo (qodo-docs-1) and can auto-tag/label PRs based on rule-driven risk classification (qodo-docs-8), with rule config-as-code at multiple levels (qodo-docs-11). This shows rule-based automatic triggering on the PR event specifically, but not a general-purpose 'define rule -> trigger arbitrary action on any event' automation engine. Missing for 10: evidence of custom/arbitrary event types beyond PR review (e.g., webhooks, scheduled triggers), and evidence of configurable action types beyond review/labeling (e.g., notifications, external integrations).
